Contract Generator.contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::genereateApprovalLetter(id: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		loanRequest: LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstance()->any(lr|lr.RequestID = id),
		approvalLetter: ApprovalLetter = ApprovalLetter.allInstance()->any(al|al.Content = 'ApprovalLetterContent')
	precondition:
		loanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = bool
	postcondition:
		let newApprovalLetter: ApprovalLetter in
		newApprovalLetter.oclIsNew() and
		LoanRequest.allInstance()->includes(loanRequest) and
		approvalLetter.Content = 'ApprovalLetterContent' and
		result = true
}
